scheme_name: Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam Shramik Pravidhik Shiksha Sahaayata Yojana
other_conditions: The worker must be employed in an establishment registered under the Shops and Commercial Establishments Act, 1962 or the Factories Act, 1948 in Uttar Pradesh.
The worker’s monthly salary (basic salary + dearness allowance) must not exceed ₹15,000.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of up to ₹25,000 for degree courses, ₹15,000 for diploma courses, and ₹10,000 for certificate courses.
